cohort: 189 mother-infant pairs at the time of delivery.
finding: Low maternal retinol concentrations were associated with maternal anemia and a trend toward low birth weight, while maternal lutein was associated with C-section and infant respiratory distress syndrome, and maternal lycopene was associated with infant growth parameters.
mod_finding: Maternal lutein was associated with C-section.
birth_weight: Mentioned, but specific values not provided
